verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Adyen exposes REST-style APIs (Legal Entity Management API, Configuration API) and at least one dedicated SDK (the auth SDK for device binding), plus a documented MCP server for natural-language integration, indicating some SDK/API tooling exists for developers. However, there is no evidence of a broader set of official language SDKs (e.g., Node/Java/Python client libraries) or a discoverable OpenAPI spec — the openapi.json probe returned 404s — so AI-native builders lack machine-readable spec access and a clear multi-language SDK catalog. missing for 10: explicit list/documentation of official multi-language SDKs, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/schema file, and independent confirmation of SDK usage in AI-native workflows.
